title: A Facebook page is not a website

shots.headline: "I have a Facebook page. I don't need a website."
shots.line: Ndine page yeFacebook, handidi website. Sound familiar?

rows: Ranks on Google for your services
No algorithm deciding who sees you
shots.headline: A page is rented space
shots.line: A Facebook page is rented space. A website is yours: it shows up on Google, takes EcoCash and Visa payments, and no algorithm decides who sees it.

shots.headline: Keep the page. Add the website.
shots.line: Keep your page for conversations, and send people to a website that closes the sale.
